description:
Discover a key's models

Reads the models the key can serve and checks that it is a paid or funded key, as a job: poll the `get_supply_job` tool every second until it is done (a few seconds: the model list only); its `models` are every model the key serves, each with its reference price and where it comes from (none anywhere: set your own price), and `paid` false means add funds and discover again. A Z.ai open-platform key (zaiKind open) lists its models as not listable for now: Z.ai open platform keys are coming soon. Each model's self-name check runs in its health test. A discovery running or done in the last ten minutes is reused unless `fresh`. Sellers only: an account that has not accepted the selling terms gets 403 not_seller.

fresh.description: Read the model list again even if it was read in the last ten minutes.
